title: Bikewatching
description: An interactive visualization of Bluebikes traffic in Bostom and Cambridge, showing station activity, arrivals, departures, and time-based filtering.

title: Persuasive or Deceptive Visualization
description: An analysis of abortion-clinic availability across the United States, featuring two visualizations and a reflection on persuasive and deceptive data visualization.

title: Education Spending and Gender Gaps in Educational Attainment
description: A collaborative interactive data visualization developed with Heta Joshi and Jade Romero. Using an animated bubble chart and World Bank data from 14 countries across the United States, Europe, and Latin America, we explore how government spending on secondary education relates to gender gaps in upper-secondary educational attainment from 2004 to 2018.

title: World Happiness Data Analysis
description: Exploratory data analysis of global happiness indicators using Python, Pandas, Matplotlib, and Jupyter Notebook. Cleaned and analyzed data across countries using descriptive statistics and visualizations to explore economic and social factors associated with happiness.

title: Poverty Level Calculator
description: A Python desktop application built with Tkinter and object-oriented programming to estimate U.S. household poverty status based on income, household size, and location using federal poverty guidelines.

title: Weather Risk Calculator
description: A Python command-line application that calculates heat index and wind chill using NOAA formulas to assess weather-related risks through interactive user inputs.
